chunks: And those that bring down the Reminder

key_terms.الْمُلْقِيَاتِ: Those that cast down or deliver (referring to angels)

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Al-Mulqiyaat' mentioned in Surah An-Naziat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to include the angels as well as the Prophet Muhammad and the Imams, who serve as carriers of divine knowledge. The term 'al-Mulqiyat' (those who cast forth) emphasizes the active dissemination of the 'Dhikr' (Reminder), linking the celestial transmission of revelation to its earthly preservation and teaching by the Ahl al-Bayt. This highlights the continuity of divine guidance from the angels to the prophets and ultimately to the Imams.
